Annotations: visual hierarchy and Gestalt principles
Figure–ground (Gestalt): the ring and label sit on top of the camera view as the figure; the camera image is the ground. The part the step names is the only outlined thing on screen.
Proximity (Gestalt): each part label is placed directly under the part it names (MAIN WASH under the left compartment), so the label is read as belonging to that part.
Similarity (Gestalt): every ‘Normal’ explanation and every success message use the same tag/box style, and every error uses the same heavy-bordered box, so users learn one look per meaning.
Common region (Gestalt): the step number, title, instruction and camera view sit in one region; caution and status boxes are separate regions below, so warnings are not mixed into steps (T5).
Visual hierarchy: step title is the largest text → instruction → camera view → caution → status → Back/Next. Primary action is the only filled button; Next stays disabled until the step is
Hierarchy for errors: error boxes appear directly below the choice that caused them and before Back/Next, with the recovery action inside the box (Try again / Choose again / Check again).
Konnect D4 Part A — grayscale wireframe flow: First wash on Panasonic NA-F135A1 (core task, alternate and error paths)

Solid arrows = user navigation. Row 1 = core task (vertical slice). Row 2 = alternate/error paths and the global ‘Is this normal?’ dialog (dashed = reachable from every screen). Grayscale only: structure, not appearance.
Row 3: live-camera tap-to-place (added after D4 build; grayscale)

Annotations (continue the numbering of the Gestalt table)
7 Signifier (Norman): dashed ring + crosshair on the camera view say 'tap here'. The camera view takes the tap
8 Feedback: P2 'Checking…' appears at once so the tap never feels ignored. The result is announced to screen
9 Constraint: Next stays disabled in P1 and P2; it enables only in P3.
10 Non-pointer path: focus the camera view, move with arrow keys, Enter places. Or press 'Place ring at the
11 Common region and proximity: the status box sits directly under the camera view it refers to.
12 Recovery: if the check fails (facilitator 'Make next check fail') P2 → E1 (error a) with Try again / Show a
drawing. 'Move ring' on P3 returns to P1.
Drawing mode skips P1 and P2: positions are exact, recognition is a 2 s timer.
